goal: Allow valid 65-byte Taproot signatures in PSBT inputs when the optional sighash type field is omitted
Prevents valid Taproot transactions such as multisig spends with mixed sighashes from failing to finalize
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Nobody has spoken for the PR yet
Objection: accepting any sighash type without an explicit field creates inconsistency with segwit v0 (fametrano)
Author agreed to consider narrowing the implicit acceptance path to DEFAULT and ALL (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes an interoperability bug where valid Taproot PSBTs fail to sign or finalize
Stops valid 65-byte explicit sighash signatures from being rejected when sighash type fields are absent
